EMANCIPATE fought with outer pair up the backstretch, cleared at the five-sixteenths pole, bumped with a riderless ALA SAWAB and steadied in tight at
the quarter pole, continued with the lead from the two path to the stretch and stayed clear under right handed urging and steady handling. RICCELLI vied
between rivals to the turn, dueled with EMANCIPATE early on the bend, got put in tight quarters by a riderless ALA SAWAB and steadied nearing the
five-sixteenths pole, moved inside then eased back off the rail, spun three wide into the lane and finished willingly for a clear second. BID fought for the lead
three deep, steadied when crowded by a riderless ALA SAWAB at the three-eighths pole, lost ground through the turn, trailed four wide into the lane and
tired. ALA SAWAB threw his head then stumbled badly a few strides out of the gate and unseated the rider in the process, ran loose on the outside up the
backstretch, bothered all three rivals while easing down to the rail through the turn, caught by the rider on the clubhouse turn and walked off. THERE WAS
AN INQUIRY CONCERNING THE START OF ALA SAWAB AND THE STEWARDS RULED THAT HE CAUSED HIS OWN PROBLEMS LEAVING THE
GATE AND WOULD BE NO CHANGE.

CAROLINA LEGACY grabbed the lead quickly, met the bid from RIDE THE TIGER at the five-sixteenths pole, turned that rival away turning for home and
powered away under strong handling and left handed encouragement. RIDE THE TIGER stalked the speed outside rivals, challenged CAROLINA LEGACY
at the five-sixteenths pole, got turned away by the winner coming into the stretch and stayed on for a clear second. YAUTOWN dropped back early, angled
out at the half-mile pole, went four deep into the turn, moved down to the three path then tipped back four wide late on the bend, showed a mild response
down the stretch and picked up the show honors. SIGMA BOY sat off the pace, chased three deep leaving the backstretch, angled to the two path then
came three wide into the lane and improved position. MARION MAGIC raced in mid-pack staying off the rail, traveled in the three path on the turn and
weakened. MY MAN HUEY was prominent early to the inside of the pacesetter, started to weaken along the rail on the turn and tired down the lane. RED
HOT LEAD broke a step slow, traveled near the back inside rivals, got put in tight and took up at the three-eighths pole, trailed a bit off the rail into the lane
and passed tired rivals. ROSTRON pursued from off the pace up the backstretch, went two wide into the turn, angled to the rail and saved ground to the
stretch, then failed to menace in the lane. GATO VOLADOR followed in range early, fell out of range in the two path on the turn and faded.

the backstretch, ridden along while four, five then six wide on the turn, chased within range with a furlong remaining, closed in steadily from outside in deep
stretch, drew alongside IRON MAN CAL late but ran out of ground. BIG CITY LIGHTS chased three deep then angled to the two path approaching the turn,
angled to the inside around the bend, rallied along the fence in the stretch and gained the show honors. STRONGHOLD raced up close on the inside,
coaxed along saving ground through the turn, tipped out in upper stretch and finished evenly. MARCH OF TIME forward placed outside the pacesetter in the
early going, applied pressure to IRON MAN CAL leaving the backstretch, could not sustain the challenge and gave chase two then three wide past the
five-sixteenths pole and flattened out in the stretch run. DR. VENKMAN tracked between runner then outside a rival, fell out of range two then three wide on
the turn and could not rally when called upon. VODKA VODKA stumbled, lost his path at the start and came in, lagged behind the field early, swung out into
the stretch and passed tired rivals. GOLD SWEEP broke out and bumped BARTHOLDY, followed in range from inside, lost ground around the turn and
weakened down the lane. JIMMY'S DAILYS stalked deep leaving the backstretch, chased three deep past the three-eighths pole, came five wide into the
stretch, drifted in briefly at the eighth pole and weakened. BARTHOLDY got bumped by GOLD SWEEP at the start, tracked three deep approaching the
turn, came four wide into the stretch and tired.
